# UX & Accessibility Requirements Checklist: Cards — user-defined order + richer colour choice

**Purpose**: Validate that the touch-interaction, feedback, accessibility and colour-readability requirements are complete, unambiguous and measurable before planning
**Created**: 2026-09-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Gesture Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK001 Is the hold that starts a reorder quantified with a duration threshold, rather than left to the plan? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the requirements that separate a tap, a scroll and a hold stated in measurable terms (timing plus movement tolerance)? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "visibly becomes draggable" defined with an observable property rather than a subjective one? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements consistent between the tap-to-activate guarantee and the hold gesture living on the same element? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]

## Feedback & Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK005 Are feedback requirements defined for each of the three phases separately — hold accepted, drag in progress, order kept? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the drop-target indication specified, so the user knows where the card will land before releasing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for reaching a position that is currently off-screen while dragging (row auto-scroll)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Are cancel and interruption requirements defined — release outside the row, an incoming call, app backgrounded mid-drag? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements defined for the single-card case, where reordering is meaningless? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Accessibility Requirements

- [ ] CHK010 Is the non-drag reorder path specified concretely enough to be built and tested, rather than named only? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK011 Are announcement requirements defined for assistive technology when a card changes position? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Are minimum touch-target requirements stated for the reorder affordance and for the colour swatches? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Are reduced-motion requirements defined for the lift and drop animation? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Colour Readability Requirements

- [ ] CHK014 Is the contrast requirement unambiguous about which text colour it is measured against? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK015 Is it specified whether the label colour may switch between light and dark depending on the chosen background? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the requirements for the low-contrast case specific about whether the warning blocks saving or only advises? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009a]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the contrast requirements stated for both themes explicitly, rather than for a single default theme? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §SC-004]

## Colour Choice Requirements

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for how a custom colour is entered (spectrum, hex input, or both)? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the "offered back when editing again" requirement specific about how many earlier custom colours are retained? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009b]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the requirements consistent between the two-tap claim for common colours and the added custom-colour flow? [Consistency, Spec §SC-006, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for two cards deliberately sharing one colour, including that the app must not block it? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK001, CHK002, CHK012, CHK013, CHK015 and CHK018 are the likely spec updates: the spec deliberately deferred the hold duration and the picker shape, and never stated target sizes, reduced-motion or label-colour switching
